iterations.prompt_text:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: independent production concept reference for original warehouse digital twin 3D models.
Style: beautiful original boxy cartoon low-poly miniature. Strong cuboid primary masses, planar flat-shaded faces, small single-step bevels, matte surfaces. Tangible thickness, coherent connected construction, depth from clean silhouettes and gentle contact shadows. Charcoal #293D46, petrol teal #2E7376, warm tan #C99A60 and warm off-white environment palette. Clean blue/orange/purple/green/yellow uniforms reserved for people. Neutral light grey studio background, soft even light. Functional simplicity with carefully designed proportions. Avoid realistic textures, weathering, tiny bolts, smooth organic characters, thin stretched parts, floating disconnected components, extra limbs and visual clutter. No copyrighted characters or brands.

Primary request: consistent four-view production reference of ONE original chunky petrol-and-tan cartoon forklift: FRONT, SIDE, REAR, THREE-QUARTER, matching dimensions/construction. Four squat faceted dark rubber wheels are grounded and visibly joined to chassis. Petrol teal cuboid front chassis and warm tan counterweight, small stepped bevels, matte dark square overhead guard with four connected supports, accessible seat/control column, sturdy vertical twin-channel mast, connected horizontal carriage and TWO parallel substantial long flat forks at low pickup height. Front shows fork spacing, side shows continuous fork-to-carriage connection and driver's seat clearance, rear shows counterweight and guard symmetry, quarter shows depth. No floating rails or extra forks. Compact industrial miniature with thick readable parts and restrained teal accents. A separate small1.70m blocky driver provides human scale, outside the four vehicle silhouettes. No realistic hoses/bolts/tire tread noise; retain necessary lifting structure.

Production composition: four large complete vehicle views in a clean2x2 sheet, FRONT upper-left, SIDE upper-right, REAR lower-left, THREE-QUARTER lower-right. Neutral light grey studio floor and soft contact shadows, all fork tips and wheels inside frame. Same wheelbase, body width, roof shape, mast height, seat, counterweight and fork spacing in every panel. Exactly four wheels in total per machine, one at each chassis corner; ordinary occlusion in straight front/rear/side views is correct, do not add extra wheels to make four simultaneously visible. Two slightly larger front tyres and two rear steering tyres, each a chunky dark faceted cylinder with one simple tan hub. Distinct broad petrol chassis, tan rear counterweight block, charcoal four-post overhead guard with a thick flat roof, one dark upright seat/backrest, steering wheel on a short connected column, open side entry and ample blocky-driver head/knee/foot clearance. The two charcoal mast rails stand vertically at the FRONT, tied into the chassis and joined by upper/lower crossmembers; a compact carriage bridges both rails. Each of exactly two warm-tan painted-metal forks has one vertical heel attached directly to that carriage and one uninterrupted horizontal flat blade extending forward, parallel and at identical low height, with sturdy thickness and short bevelled tips. No detached floating blade and no rear-facing extra forks. Keep forks unloaded and the cabin empty so the structure can be read. Place one small standing yellow-uniform cuboid driver with simple forklift badge beside a1.70m height marker in a separate narrow scale inset, without overlapping any vehicle. Driver follows the accepted R01/R05 cuboid head/body language. Do not turn the machine into a realistic CAD model: beautiful original matte boxy-cartoon construction with useful depth, small stepped bevels and deliberate large shapes. No bright role-uniform colors on vehicle body; petrol/charcoal/tan only.
